```yaml
name: Auto‑approve workflows

on:
  pull_request_target:
    types: [labeled, unlabeled, synchronize]
    branches:
      - main
      - 'release-*'

jobs:
  approve:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      actions: write
      pull-requests: read
      contents: read
    steps:
      - name: Install jq
        run: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y jq

      - name: Check for ok‑to‑test label
        id: label
        run: |
          if echo "${{ toJSON(github.event.pull_request.labels) }}" | jq -e '.[] | select(.name=="ok-to-test")' > /dev/null; then
            echo "ok_to_test=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "ok_to_test=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Determine if contributor is returning
        id: contributor
        run: |
          PR_COUNT=$(curl -s -H "Authorization: token ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}" \
            "https://api.github.com/search/issues?q=repo:${{ github.repository }}+type:pr+author:${{ github.event.pull_request.user.login }}+state:closed" | jq '.total_count')
          if [ "$PR_COUNT" -gt 1 ]; then
            echo "returning=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "returning=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Approve pending workflow runs
        if: steps.label.outputs.ok_to_test == 'true' || steps.contributor.outputs.returning == 'true'
        run: |
          RUN_IDS=$(curl -s -H "Authorization: token ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}" \
            "https://api.github.com/repos/${{ github.repository }}/actions/runs?head_sha=${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}&status=action_required" | jq -r '.workflow_runs[].id')
          for RUN_ID in $RUN_IDS; do
            echo "Approving run $RUN_ID"
            curl -s -X POST -H "Authorization: token ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}" \
              "https://api.github.com/repos/${{ github.repository }}/actions/runs/$RUN_ID/approval"
          done
```
